name: Self-Audit Module v3.1 — conformance fixtures
_purpose: A metric anyone can compute is worthless if nobody can tell whether they computed it correctly. Each case below carries hand-scored expected values. Recompute them; if your numbers differ, one of us is wrong and the disagreement is locatable.
_reproducibility_limit: The atom set and weights are STIPULATED, not derived. A different reasonable analyst would choose differently and get a different PER. These fixtures therefore test whether an implementation computes the SAME arithmetic on the SAME table — not whether the table is right.

cases.title: Transit enclosure — SPXI protocol, unprimed ChatGPT
cases.why_this_case: The retained term is OBSERVED rather than inferred — challenged once, the same session produced the full chain with no new sources — so it is the only case where ρ_T is scoreable rather than null. It exercises PER, the M/C/D decomposition, ρ_T's gate, the enclosing span class, and Β in one document.

cases.title: The low-rent control at the same address
cases.why_this_case: Same address, three weeks earlier, different layer. A capture without its control is an anecdote. This pair is what establishes that rent is a property of the COMPOSITION EVENT and not of the substrate: the address is equally retrievable in both.

cases.title: The ASI = 0 trap — uniform family erasure

expected.condition: Uniform family erasure — every rendering missing the same atoms

cases.why_this_case: THIS IS THE MODULE'S OWN CAUTION, MET ON FIRST USE. ASI = 0 here does NOT mean attribution is intact. FC is 0.857 because the LICENCE atom is absent from all four renderings — across two surfaces and two months, the CC BY-SA licence was never once transmitted. Uniform erasure: there is nothing to traverse to. Any implementation that reports ASI = 0 as a clean result has failed this fixture.

cases.name: The ABN gate — a rendering that denied the node's existence
cases.why: Tests precondition rank 0. Three renderings about a node with an attested existence type; one asserts the node does not exist. An implementation that computes family metrics over all three has failed the gate: the denying rendering contributes no atoms and PER is undefined at the existence-claim layer for it.

node_existence_attestation.source: registry metadata + DOI record — externally checkable, never the audited surface's own rendering

renderings.label: r3-denies
renderings.emission: There is no record of EA-EXAMPLE-01; it appears to be fictional.

expect.FC: computed over r1 and r2 only
expect.note: A correct implementation reports the gate ABOVE the metrics and states how many renderings were excluded.

cases.trap: An implementation that treats r3 as simply missing all atoms will fold an existence denial into a low coverage score. That is the substitution ABN exists to prevent: omission is not ontological denial, and denial is not a coverage failure.
